03-01: Becomes the most sought-after bachelor in Petersburg after inheriting his fortune [1].
Socially managed by @Vasily, who takes over his affairs and installs him in his own house [2, 3].
03-02: Experiences a moment of intense physical attraction to @Hélène during a soirée [4, 5].
Is socially pressured into an engagement with @Hélène on her name day, despite his misgivings [6, 7].
04-04: Receives an anonymous letter about @Hélène’s infidelity with @Dólokhov [8].
Challenges @Dólokhov to a duel during a club dinner after @Dólokhov insults him [9, 10].
04-05: Wounds @Dólokhov in the duel despite having never held a pistol before [11].
04-06: Realizes he never loved @Hélène and considers his marriage a 'vile, idle' mistake [12-15].
Has a violent confrontation with @Hélène, nearly hitting her with a marble slab before demanding a separation [16].
05-01: Meets the Mason @Bazdéev at a post station; experiences a spiritual crisis and decides to join the Brotherhood [17-25].
05-03: Is initiated into Freemasonry in Petersburg [26-45].
05-10: Attempts to liberate his serfs and build hospitals, but is systematically deceived by his head steward [46-56].
05-11: Visits @Andrew at Boguchárovo; finds his friend cynical and 'dead' in spirit [57, 58].
05-12: Debates the existence of God and future life with @Andrew on a ferry; believes he has reignited @Andrew’s spiritual fire [59-64].

03-12: Learns that the French have crossed the Thabor Bridge due to a ruse [65-68].
Dreams of his own 'Toulon'—a moment of glory that will make him famous [67, 69].
03-15: Meets the Emperor @Alexander-I at the front; notices @Kutúzov's submission to the Tsar [70-76].
03-16: Seizes the fallen standard during the retreat at Austerlitz and leads a charge, but is wounded and falls [77, 78].
03-19: Lies wounded on the field, contemplating the 'lofty sky' and the insignificance of @Napoleon [79, 80].
Napoleon finds him and orders him to be taken to a dressing station [81].
04-07: Returns home to Bald Hills exactly as his wife @Lise enters labor; he has been presumed dead by his family [82, 83].
04-09: Witnesses the death of @Lise during childbirth; feels a sense of unredeemable guilt [84, 85].
05-08: Retires to his estate at Boguchárovo; avoids active service to care for his son [86].
05-12: Engages in a philosophical debate with @Pierre; though outwardly cynical, the meeting marks a spiritual turning point for him [61, 64].

03-07: Visits @Borís and @Berg in the Guards' camp; feels a veteran's contempt for their 'dandyism' [87].
03-08: Is overcome with ecstatic love for the Emperor @Alexander-I during a review [88-90].
03-13: Serves on the skirmishing line; dreams of a chance encounter with the Emperor [91].
03-18: Witnesses the chaotic defeat at Austerlitz; sees the Emperor standing alone and dejected but is too bashful to approach him [92-95].
04-01: Returns to Moscow on leave with his friend @Denísov; greeted with rapture by his family [96, 97].
04-13: Is lured into a card game by @Dólokhov, who is vengeful after @Sónya's refusal [98-101].
04-14: Loses 43,000 rubles to @Dólokhov, a sum calculated by @Dólokhov based on his and @Sónya’s ages [102, 103].
04-16: Confesses his gambling debt to his father; is moved by the old count’s gentle response [104-106].
05-19: Travels to Tilsit to petition the Emperor for @Denísov's pardon; observes the friendly meeting between @Alexander-I and @Napoleon [107, 108].
05-21: Feels conflicted and angry after seeing @Napoleon reward a Russian soldier while @Denísov remains unpardoned; insists a soldier's duty is 'not to think' [109-112].

04-01: Welcomes @Nicholas home; she has grown into a 'tornado' of a young woman [96, 97].
04-12: Attends Iogel's ball; chooses @Denísov for a mazurka and is amazed by his skill [113-115].
04-16: Receives a marriage proposal from @Denísov; refuses him, stating she loves him only as a friend [116, 117].

03-03: Endures a visit from @Anatole and @Vasily; is pressured by @Lise to dress up for the suitor [118-120].
03-05: Witnesses @Anatole embracing @Bourienne in the conservatory; chooses to refuse his proposal to remain with her father [121-125].
04-08: Cares for @Lise during labor; is the first to see @Andrew upon his unexpected return [82, 126].
05-13: Continues to host 'God’s folk' (pilgrims) at Bald Hills against her father's wishes [127-129].

03-09: Decides to serve according to the 'unwritten law' of social influence rather than the military code [130-132].
05-06: Becomes an intimate in @Hélène’s Petersburg salon and rises in social status [133, 134].
05-19: Present at the meeting of the two Emperors at Tilsit; has become a successful, polished courtier [135].

04-03: Compromises @Hélène in Moscow; is rumored to be her lover [136].
04-05: Is wounded in a duel by @Pierre; reveals a surprising, tender devotion to his mother and sister [11, 137].
04-13: Proposes to @Sónya but is refused; seeks revenge by ruining @Nicholas at cards [102, 138].

03-02: Maneuvers @Pierre into marriage through social expectation and physical allure [7, 139].
04-06: Blames @Pierre for the duel with @Dólokhov; mocks his jealousy and agrees to a separation for a large portion of his fortune [16, 140, 141].
05-06: Returns to Petersburg society; assumes the role of a 'suffering' wife while flirting with @Borís [142, 143].

04-16: Proposes to @Natásha and is refused by her and the @Countess-Rostóva [117, 144].
05-16: Seizes a transport of provisions to save his starving men; attacks the official @Telyánin when he discovers he is involved in the supply chain [145-147].
05-17: Enters the hospital with a wound and a pending court-martial for the transport incident [148, 149].
